summary.text: Ron Winterton is a Republican state senator from Utah who has represented District 20 since 2019 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a consultant and former county commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Ron Winterton, listed by Ballotpedia as Ronald Winterton, graduated from Union High School.
His career experience includes work as a professional service consultant, owner and operator of Winterton Transportation, and driver at Basin Wholesale West.
Before joining the Senate he served as a county commissioner and on the tri-county health board and the Utah Basin Association of Government board.
In 2023-2024 Winterton chaired the Senate Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment Committee and was vice chair of the Government Operations and Political Subdivisions Committee.
